name: airbrake_sourcemaps
title: Read Airbrake source maps
description: Read Airbrake source maps: list, get. Read-only — to upload a local source map use airbrake_sourcemaps_upload; to delete use airbrake_delete with resource "sourcemap". sourcemap_id MUST be passed as a string. List results include `_pagination.has_more`/`next_page`. Returns the raw Airbrake JSON payload — no data is removed unless list is given `fields` (keeps only those top-level keys per item).

fields.description: List actions only: keep just these top-level keys (exact names as Airbrake returns them, e.g. ["id","createdAt"]) on each listed item. Omit for the full payload.
